content.body: When using ambush tactics it is a good idea to practice a "fire and move" system. Once you have scored a kill, it is probable that other enemies have seen or heard where you are, and will be coming for you. Keep your engines off when not moving! Press (e) for engines, press right or left square brackets [ ] to shift up or down gears, press (r) to go into reverse - use right square bracket key after going into reverse to engage transmission.
